title: [ingest] Context edges default to weight 0.5 when unspecified
summary: DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WEIGHT = 0.5: an edge with no explicit weight reads back as 0.5 (back-compat). Weight is ignored entirely for blocking/supersede edges — it only matters for context (relevance-traversal) edges.
